title: The Grunion Run, 2014
logline: The run, and the dog at fifteen doesn't go down to the water. Wood sits with him above the tide line while the lanterns work the surf. The panels get wider going down.

panels.composition: The night beach, lanterns along the surf, people bent at the water.

image.prompt: a night beach with lanterns along a surf line and people bent at the water, black ink with one spot tone

panels.composition: BARNABY, old, sitting on the sand above the tide line, looking at the lights.

image.prompt: an old dog sitting on dark sand above a tide line looking at distant lantern lights, black ink

panels.composition: WOOD sitting down beside him, coat pulled around.

image.prompt: a man in a coat sitting down on dark sand beside an old dog, black ink

panels.composition: The two of them from behind, small, the surf silver with fish far below them.

image.prompt: a man and an old dog seen from behind sitting on dark sand with a surf line silver with small fish far below, black ink with one spot tone

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays
